body: I assume null termination is not necessary, since it had `-1` before.

Also, shouldn't it be `formatted_data.ptr() + data_sent`. It will work if it's sent in a single iteration, but if it's not next one will try to send it from the start instead of sending the remaining part.

```suggestion
			Error err = connection->put_partial_data(formatted_data.ptr() + data_sent, formatted_data.size() - data_sent, curr_sent);
```

For the reference, the same code for GDScript do add it:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/1f56d96cf2c768c3844c68ccb504dfeee841ae15/modules/gdscript/language_server/gdscript_language_protocol.cpp#L107-L114

> Also, shouldn't it be formatted_data.ptr() + data_sent. It will work if it's sent in a single iteration, but if it's not next one will try to send it from the start instead of sending the remaining part.

Oh yeah, nice catch!

> I assume null termination is not necessary, since it had -1 before.

Exactly, or rather, the documentation [does not specify](https://microsoft.github.io/debug-adapter-protocol/overview#content-part) if that detail is necessary of not. Since we have a field denoting how many bytes the content will have, I've assumed this refers to the whole encoded JSON packet itself, without the null terminator char.

I've tested that content length remains the same after this MR, and that's because `get_utf8_buffer()` doesn't include the null terminator char:
![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8eafdd36-9ae6-4011-9e91-43cae17ad0b0)

Fixed; I did a "hack" to test this scenario, and it behaves as expected.
